# Unshakeable Foundations
## Scripture
"And Jesus answered them, 'Have faith in God. Truly, I say to you, whoever says to this mountain, 'Be taken up and cast into the sea,' and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will come to pass, he will have whatever he says.'" – Mark 11:22-23

## Reflection
As men, we often face challenges that test our faith and resolve. We are called to stand firm in our convictions, just like the apostle Peter who was commissioned by Jesus to walk on water. But when the winds of doubt and fear arise, it's easy to lose our footing. In today's scripture, Jesus reminds us that our faith is not just a feeling, but a choice that we make every day. When we say that we trust in God, we must mean it with every fiber of our being. We must believe that His power is real and that He is able to move mountains. As we go about our daily lives, let us choose to trust in the unshakeable foundations of God's Word and His promise to be with us always.

## Daily Challenge
"Write down three things you are thankful for in your life and three areas where you need God's help. Pray through them together with your Heavenly Father before you start your day."
